name: MPT
effectsSummary: MPT as a poorly studied tryptamine with anecdotal effects; its oral dose/duration table contains only placeholders.
dosageRemark: The oral dose and duration values are placeholders (three question marks), not usable measurements. Toxicity and long-term recreational effects are unstudied and the exact toxic dose is unknown, so no numeric dose bands are inferred.
generalRisks: Recreational toxicity and long-term health effects appear unstudied, exact toxic dose is unknown and human-use history is very limited.
longtermRisks: Long-term recreational health effects have not been studied in a scientific context.
saferUse: Independent research and harm reduction are recommended. The oral dose table is placeholder-only and must not be interpreted as quantitative guidance.
summary: MPT is a poorly studied tryptamine. Its archived oral dose and duration fields are placeholders, and human toxicity data are unavailable.
